The Chinese characters for Seth

As a transliteration, Seth is usually written 塞思 (Sāi sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

塞
Sāi
block, fort
思
sī
think, thought

Origin and meaning

From Hebrew, Seth carries the meaning “appointed”.

About the name Seth

In the Bible, Seth was the third son of Adam and Eve.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Seth as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “appointed”, is part of the appeal.
